Pose 00, idle beginning: Retto sits with both real front paws grounded and four legs visible. Its eyes and head angle gently 5 degrees down toward the small space between its image-left shoulder and the left cat pet, as if noticing a drifting feather not drawn here. Chest gently inhaling. Left companion looks up inward at that same space with its hands lowered but beginning to open. Right companion faces slightly inward, hands relaxed, ears softly tilted by breeze. Main wings half-open relaxed, tail tip beginning a small rightward curl. This is the cheerful curious starting anchor of a smooth feather-relay loop.

Pose 01: preparation in-between. Retto's whole head/neck turns another 2 degrees down-left, shoulders respond subtly; right anatomical front paw (screen-left) still grounded but wrist flexes ready to lift. Left cat raises its inward hand a little and follows the invisible feather with gaze. Right rabbit turns eyes/head slightly left. Wing outer feathers begin a small breeze flex right; tail tip gently curls.

Pose 02: Retto lifts its anatomical right front paw (screen-left) off the floor to about x365,y1180, bent elbow attached naturally to shoulder, no duplicate paw at old place. Other forepaw and both rear paws planted. Head and chest lean just slightly toward left pet, curious friendly eyes. Left cat opens both palms at its chest, looking inward-up; rabbit watches, arms begin opening.

Pose 03: anatomical midpoint of the paw lift. Main screen-left forepaw rises to x330,y1030 with smoothly flexed elbow, shoulder and neck connected. Retto watches its paw with soft pleased expression. Left cat raises both hands toward x230,y930 to prepare a catch, body tilts inward by only 5 degrees. Rabbit leans inward to watch, long ears lag lightly.

Pose 04: contact anchor. Retto extends ONLY its anatomical right forepaw toward screen-left, paw centered x310,y945, palm gently up as if just touching underside of a feather not drawn here. Elbow bent and attached to right shoulder, no extra grounded front paw. Other front paw and two rear feet planted. Whole head/neck inclined down-left, original face size, warm attentive eyes and tiny pleased feline mouth. Left cat reaches both hands toward x230,y925, palms cupped ready to receive, eyes on Retto's lifted paw. Right rabbit leans slightly inward watching with hands near chest. Wings flex a few degrees back with Retto's shoulder movement, tail tip trails right.

Pose 05: follow-through after tap. Retto's same lifted paw rises gently another 25px to x300,y920 then begins arcing back; gaze follows the invisible feather toward left companion. Left cat extends cupped hands closer toward x245,y915 and tilts its head up, joyful closed smile. Rabbit slightly lifts both arms in anticipation. Main paw count stays four total, wing roots attached.

Pose 06: release midpoint. Retto retracts the same paw down-inward to x335,y1025, fingers relaxed. Head/eyes still down-left to monitor catch. Left cat lifts both hands fully to x230,y915, cupping the absent feather between them; elbows articulated, feet remain near same position. Rabbit watches left pet, ears lean with wind, ribbon ends lag gently.

Pose 07: catch beat. Retto lowers same forepaw to x370,y1100, watches left pet with small happy head tilt. Left cat closes hands into a soft cradle at x225,y930 and dips wrists slightly to absorb the feather catch, joyful soft expression. Right rabbit raises inward (screen-left) hand toward the group, head interested. Tail and wings gently settling from paw action.

Pose 08: left cat releases onward. Retto lowers its lifted forepaw to x385,y1200, gaze beginning to turn from left toward center through a complete continuous neck/shoulder pose. Left cat extends its cupped hands up-right to x255,y915 then opens them, body tilting slightly inward, pleased closed smile. Right rabbit's inward hand rises to x800,y930 preparing to receive. No drawn feather or magical effects.

Pose 09: passing across chest. Retto replaces same forepaw on ground nearly original position, head neutral but eyes track across lower chest toward right; shoulders relaxed, warm expression. Left cat's open hands follow through down to chest. Right rabbit turns head further inward, bends both elbows forward and opens hands, long ears trailing slightly. Main wings relaxed half-open.

Pose 10: rabbit preparation. Retto turns head/neck and upper chest gently 5 degrees toward image-right, following the invisible feather toward rabbit. All four main feet grounded. Left cat lowers hands toward belly, looking right. Right rabbit extends its inward hand toward x775,y930 and other hand under it, slight happy head tilt, ears gently splayed, body size unchanged.

Pose 11: rabbit contact. Retto head turns another 2 degrees right, bright friendly eyes focused on rabbit's inward hand, chest relaxed. Left cat watches rabbit with hands near belly. Right rabbit reaches inward further to x760,y915 with one hand and cups the other beneath, small open-armed enthusiastic pose without changing red rectangular eyes or closed w mouth; winglets flex lightly and bow ends trail.

Pose 12: rabbit feather flick follow-through. Retto keeps a pleased gentle rightward head tilt, eyes following upward from rabbit's hands. Right rabbit lifts its inward palm from x760,y915 to x790,y875 as if softly brushing feather upward, other hand opens outward, body leans inward only 5 degrees; ears and ribbon follow naturally. Left cat looks upward toward rabbit, one hand lifted at chest, smiling.

Pose 13: recovery starts. Retto returns head/neck halfway from right toward front, ears relaxed and soft lids beginning a pleased slow blink, original muzzle closed. Rabbit retracts its hand halfway toward chest and begins returning body upright, ears lagging then settling; left cat lowers its chest hand and returns gaze toward Retto. All main paws remain planted, wing tips drift slightly right.

Pose 14: settle intermediate. Retto head nearly front with eyelids gently 70 percent open, a warm content expression, chest slight exhale, tail tip easing toward original curve. Left pet arms almost lowered and head turning back toward the empty space near Retto's screen-left shoulder. Right rabbit hands almost lowered, ears recovering from breeze, relaxed friendly body.

Pose 15: loop bridge into Pose00. Retto eyes reopening to 90 percent and whole head/neck gently starting 2 degrees down-left, preparing to notice next drifting feather. All four paws in original grounded positions; body/chest same volume and placement, wings almost initial half-open pose, tail tip just before initial curl. Left cat has hands lowered just beginning to open and eyes turning inward-up, right rabbit almost initial relaxed inward-facing stance. Make the final-to-first pose gap small and anatomically smooth.
